items.title: [Test] Add Kimi-K3 W4A8 EP256 accuracy test on A5 for v0.30.0
items.author: CuiZ2007
items.excerpt: Add a native YAML-driven accuracy case for Kimi-K3 W4A8 MXFP/QuaRot, pre-pruned to 256 routed experts, on one A5 node with eight NPUs. This provides release-branch coverage using the existing single-node harness and AISBench integration. -
